kernel_query_followup.cause: Kernel evdev_handle_get_val flushes only the calling evdev client EV_KEY queue. Same-client state query could erase a complete press/release between pre/post readiness polls while reporting neutral.
kernel_query_followup.fix: Independent read-only os.open calls per device create watch and query clients; dup is not used in runtime. Only query client gets ioctls, only untouched watch client gets readiness watches/polls. Original exact metadata before/after both fds. Second-open failure retains first actual fd until owner cleanup. No raw event read, device configuration or grab.

contract.catalog: Fixed optional libudev.so.1, explicit pointer-sized C ABI and64-bit dev_t on supported Linux64. Kernel and udev input change monitors precede complete enumeration. ID_INPUT=1 event interfaces assigned exact logind physical seat, documented missing ID_SEAT=seat0. Ignore only parent/no-node and alternative mouse/js interfaces; unknown/uninitialized/duplicate/missing catalog fails. <=256 total entries and64 selected event devices; no truncation. Any input change notification, even another seat, conservatively invalidates.
contract.permissions: Same non-root real/effective UID as verified active local Wayland SessionInspector. Only existing read permissions; no chmod, ACL/udev rules, input group changes, root helper, TakeControl or permission request. Root-owned non-writable /dev and /dev/input; canonical no-follow event nodes, character type/devnum/current inode/owner/group/mode/ctime and current read access checked on both actual opens.
contract.state: Linux little-endian64 x86_64/aarch64/riscv64 generic read ioctl ABI only. Actual EV_VERSION, full uint16-domain8192-byte bitmaps and all held keys/buttons; Type-B tracking IDs of every slot up to64 must be-1. Unknown/type-A/incomplete contact state rejected; single-contact tagged devices require supported touch/tool state. No event-content read or input write/grab/mask/routing change.
contract.watch: Kernel/udev plus untouched evdev watch fds readiness and POLLERR/HUP/NVAL cause irreversible invalidation. Snapshot/readiness bracket catalog/state/identity checks; after latch watches are removed to avoid a level-triggered hot loop, while actual fds remain owned. At most66 watched fds and130 total native fds for64 devices. Initial actual250ms quiet window, prepare3s/check1s observation bounds.
contract.ownership: Original shielded operation retains actual executor until return even on waiter/actual-task cancellation or observation timeout. Concurrent checks share one operation. Failed unwatch keeps fd; original thread close task persists across timeout/caller cancellation. Ambiguous close/unref never retried against recycled fd/C pointer and never reports clean.
contract.control: Internal one-time ControlSession.prepare_input_monitor only after independent exact system grant. system_check retains original Portal/logind proof without recursion; normal control/EI guards additionally check prepared kernel monitor. Monitor failure revokes granted devices. Close settles original EI key release first, then original monitor/thread/fds, then actual Portal Session/subscriptions. Late prepare keeps original task and Session.
contract.scope: Only kernel/udev seat devices covered by this optional source. It is not proof of arbitrary non-evdev compositor/remote inputs, native focus/selected window/region identity or app results. Production worker/business input is not enabled; missing read permissions make source unavailable. No standard Portal/InputCapture/idle/EI sync is substituted for these facts.
